Solutions

Fleet

Vehicle management, driver scheduling, fuel and maintenance tracking. Costs flow to the operation file that generated them.

What you get

  • Vehicle register — asset tracking, registration, insurance, depreciation
  • Driver management — licenses, certifications, assignments, hours tracking
  • Fuel management — purchases, consumption analysis, cost per kilometre
  • Maintenance scheduling — preventive, corrective, cost tracking
  • Route planning — multi-stop optimization, time windows, capacity utilization
  • Cost allocation — every trip, every load, every cost centre

How it posts to the ledger

Fuel purchases, maintenance costs, depreciation — each posts to the fleet cost centre, then to the operation file that generated the trip. Fleet is never a black box.
